meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 把一个智能体小组改为在本地电脑上的模型运行：修改配置，让请求发送到本地模型服务并设定模型名，还可以选择屏蔽云端接口防意外扣费；最后重新构建、重启服务并验证是否成功。
howto.when: 当你想把某个智能体小组切到本地模型、省 API 费用或试开源模型，同时本地已装好 Ollama、拉好模型、且该小组已存在时触发。

say.text: 把某个智能体小组切换到本地 Ollama 模型
say.note: 技能会询问具体是哪个小组和哪个模型。

say.text: 让智能体小组别再花 API 费用，改用本地模型
say.note: 技能将修改配置指向本地 Ollama，并重启验证。

say.text: 给代理组配好 Ollama，并屏蔽云端 Anthropic 地址
say.note: 它会设置环境变量和屏蔽域名，再重启服务。

howto.what_en: It redirects an agent group to a local Ollama model: modifies container env and shared settings to point to Ollama, may block api.anthropic.com to prevent spend, rebuilds and restarts the service, then verifies it works.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to run an agent group on a local model, cut API costs, or try open-weight models — provided Ollama is installed, a model is pulled, and the group exists.

say_en.text: Switch an agent group to a local Ollama model
say_en.note: It will ask for the group name, model, and whether to block Anthropic.

say_en.text: Make the agent group stop using paid API and use a local model
say_en.note: It will edit the config to point to Ollama, restart, and verify.

say_en.text: Set up Ollama for the agent group and block the Anthropic endpoint
say_en.note: It will set env vars and host blocking, then restart.
